## Checklist

- [ ] CI is green (`lint + types`, `unit tests`, `integration`)
- [ ] Self-review done (e.g. `/code-review`) and findings addressed
- [ ] New or changed behavior is covered by tests
- [ ] No silent `except`: every caught error is handled or re-raised with context
- [ ] No personal data stored or displayed (host/reviewer names and IDs) — see `docs/DATA.md`
- [ ] No Inside Airbnb data, derived data, or embeddings added to the repo
- [ ] No test calls the real Anthropic API
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior or design changed (`docs/*.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`)
